newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar firms, debt futures ease on data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar firms, debt futures ease on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar firmed and debt futures eased after the March quarter inflation report came in much in line with expectations.
The dollar was at US$0.7751/56 compared with US$0.7747/52 just before the data release, while June 10-year bond futures were 92.200 against a pre-data 92.250.
June bills also eased, moving to 94.11 from 94.15.

The headline CPI rose 0.2 percent for an annual rate of 1.3 percent, while the underlying rate rose 0.4 percent giving 2.1 percent year-on-year inflation. Resepective median forecasts had centre on quarterly increases of 0.1 and 0.4 percent.
